property_summary: Rule: Only the contract owner can successfully withdraw the contract balance via withdrawAll() (so after any sendMoney(...) call the contract balance cannot be drained by a non-owner); the mutant removing the onlyOwner check allows a non-owner to withdraw and thus can change contract balance/withdrawAll outcome for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove requirement check so onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts access (allows anyone to call withdrawAll).
